priority.description: Assign only concrete defects introduced or worsened by this change. P0: an emergency, catastrophic defect with immediate broad impact. P1: a reachable defect or approved-contract violation with material correctness, data, security, reliability, or compatibility impact; P0 and P1 block release. P2: a real but conditional, contained, recoverable, or non-urgent defect; advisory only. P3: a low-impact real defect or optional improvement; advisory only. Do not report pure style, naming, preference, ordinary maintainability, or scale speculation without evidence.
